prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1070; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid edge is bent, with the tail light assembly broken loose on the driver side. The damage pattern lines up well with the rear-end impact that was reported, and nothing in the photos points to older harm on the vehicle. The plan is to replace the bumper cover, straighten the lid flange, and install a new tail light assembly, then refinish the affected panels. The labor hours requested are consistent with this scope of work, and the parts and charges listed show no repeated entries.
